pantheon_surface: Node Details (Node Ready=False on node join)

evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Newly created GKE node is stuck in NotReady. Inspect node conditions and kubelet registration state.

expected_findings.root_cause: Audited node initialization and container runtime startup state. Verified absence of KubeletNotReady or bootstrap script failures.
expected_findings.remediation: Document node serial console log inspection procedures (`gcloud compute instances get-serial-port-output`) for failed VM bootstrapping.

passing_criteria: Must query full node conditions block without truncation
Must verify Ready condition, heartbeat timestamp, and reason
Must outline serial console triage procedure for bootstrap failures

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Node reports Ready=False with condition NetworkUnavailable=True: RouteCreated. Diagnose CNI initialization.

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates hardware/kubelet failure from networking datapath (Dataplane V2 / Cilium agent) route creation delay.
expected_findings.decision: Identifies Dataplane V2 agent pod status on the node and verifies if CNI plugin successfully established pod CIDR routes.

passing_criteria: Must inspect CNI daemonset health on target node
Must recommend CNI pod restart or route table validation

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Nodes in cluster dbs-mgmt-primary all report Ready=True. Are there node join failures?

expected_findings.behavior: Observes 100% of nodes in Ready status with recent heartbeat timestamps. Confirms healthy node pool; zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must verify all nodes report Ready=True
Must confirm heartbeat timestamps are current
